==================== FILE: ./css/base.css ====================
/* File: css/base.css
 * Owner: Person B (Saurav)
 * AI-assisted: YES — Gemini, 2026-11-15. Reviewed by a human: YES Reviewd by Person C (Yochan)
 * Sources used: none
 */
* {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

img {
  user-select: none;
  -webkit-user-select: none;
  -webkit-user-drag: none;
  -webkit-touch-callout: none;
}

body {
  margin: 0;
  min-height: 100vh;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--text);
  font: 16px/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
}

header {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 5;
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 8px 14px;
  background: #0d2640f2;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.home-link {
  text-decoration: none;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.home-link h1 {
  margin: 0 10px 0 0;
}

.home-link:hover h1 {
  opacity: 0.85;
}

h1 {
  margin: 0 10px 0 0;
  font: 700 24px system-ui, sans-serif;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  color: var(--accent);
}

h2 {
  margin: 4px 0 8px;
  font-size: 1.35rem;
}

h3 {
  margin: 14px 0 6px;
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  color: var(--accent);
}

button,
select,
input[type="text"],
textarea {
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 8px 14px;
  font: inherit;
  color: var(--text);
  background: var(--panel);
  border: 1px solid #3c78b5;
  border-radius: 6px;
  transition: background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, transform 0.1s ease;
}

button {
  background: var(--line);
  cursor: pointer;
}

button:hover:not(:disabled) {
  background: #3570ab;
  border-color: #63a4e6;
}

button:active:not(:disabled) {
  transform: translateY(1px);
}

button:focus-visible,
select:focus-visible,
input:focus-visible,
textarea:focus-visible,
[tabindex]:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

button:disabled {
  opacity: 0.45;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

/* Integrated Audio Mute Button + Volume Slider */
.audio-control {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 0 10px 0 0;
  background: #102a46;
  border: 1px solid #3c78b5;
  border-radius: 6px;
}

.audio-control #mute {
  border: 0;
  border-right: 1px solid #295c8f;
  border-radius: 5px 0 0 5px;
  min-height: 42px;
}

.audio-control input[type="range"] {
  width: 78px;
  height: 6px;
  padding: 0;
  min-height: 0;
  accent-color: var(--ok);
  background: #08182b;
  border-radius: 4px;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.audio-control.is-muted input[type="range"] {
  accent-color: var(--muted);
  opacity: 0.6;
}

.team-toggle {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 0 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.team-toggle input {
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
}

#nav {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 4px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

#nav button {
  background: transparent;
}

#nav button.on {
  background: var(--accent);
  color: #0b2038;
  font-weight: 700;
}

#nav button.done {
  border-color: var(--ok);
}

#app {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  flex: 1;
  overflow: auto;
  padding: 14px 16px;
}

.st {
  display: none;
}

.st.on {
  display: block;
}

.row {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px;
}

.lock {
  opacity: 0.35;
  pointer-events: none;
}

[hidden] {
  display: none !important;
}

#bg {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  z-index: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0.92;
  transform: translateZ(0);
  will-change: transform;
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  header {
    padding: 6px 10px;
    gap: 6px;
  }
  button,
  select {

/* File: css/pages/dashboard.css
 * Owner: Person B (Saurav)

#title {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 9;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 16px;
  text-align: center;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 68% 32%, #14365a33, #07162994 72%);
}

.tbox {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  max-width: 740px;
  padding: 24px 28px;
  background: #091b30c4;
  border: 1px solid #3c78b577;
  border-radius: 18px;
  box-shadow: 0 18px 48px #030a14aa;
}

.tbox .row {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  justify-content: center;
}

.tbox h1 {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 8vw, 4.5rem);
  letter-spacing: 8px;
  text-shadow: 0 4px 22px #040d18cc;
  cursor: pointer;
  user-select: none;
}

.tbox p {
  margin: 0 0 10px;
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  color: #dce9f7;
  text-shadow: 0 2px 10px #040d18cc;
}

#start {
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #0b2038;
  background: var(--accent);
  border: 0;
}

#start:hover:not(:disabled) {
  background: #ffd475;
}

/* Pure GPU translate3d animation without drop-shadow repaints */
.trk {
  height: 165px;
  will-change: transform;
  animation: bob 3.2s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.tmars {
  position: fixed;
  right: -30px;
  bottom: -45px;
  width: 240px;
  z-index: 1;
  opacity: 0.85;
  pointer-events: none;
}

@keyframes bob {
  0%, 100% { transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0); }
  50% { transform: translate3d(0, -10px, 0); }
}

body:has(#title:not([hidden])) header,
body:has(#title:not([hidden])) #app {
  visibility: hidden;
}

#cr {
  margin: 0 !important;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: var(--muted);
}

.mission-badge {
  float: right;
  width: 130px;
  margin: 0 0 8px 14px;
}

#s4 li {
  margin: 4px 0;
}

#s4 .box {
  max-width: 820px;
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .tbox {
    padding: 18px 14px;
  }
  .tmars {
    display: none;
  }
  .trk {
    height: 130px;
  }
  .mission-badge {
    float: none;
    display: block;
    margin: 0 auto 12px;
  }
}

/* Full-bleed blueprint grid across the entire canvas viewport at every zoom level */
#cv {

  background-image:
    linear-gradient(#5da9ff1e 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg, #5da9ff1e 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(#5da9ff0c 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg, #5da9ff0c 1px, transparent 1px),
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 48%, #1d4b7a66, #08182be8 78%);
  background-size:
    80px 80px,
    80px 80px,
    20px 20px,
    20px 20px,
    100% 100%;
  background-attachment: local, local, local, local, scroll;
  border: 1.5px solid #4484c4;

  letter-spacing: 0.4px;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.resource-system-content {
  padding: 4px 10px 10px;
  border-top: 1px solid #295c8f66;
}

.resource-system-content .m:first-child {
  margin-top: 4px;
}

.sub-branch {
  color: var(--accent);
  font-weight: 700;
}

/* Compact Engineering Alerts Reminder Dropdown */
.alerts-box {
  margin-bottom: 10px;
  background: #0b2038cc;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 8px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.alerts-box.bad {
  border-color: var(--bad);
}

.alerts-box.w {
  border-color: var(--accent);
}

.alerts-box.ok {
  border-color: var(--ok);
}

.alerts-box > summary {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 8px;
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 6px 10px;
  cursor: pointer;
  list-style: none;
  user-select: none;
  font-size: 0.92rem;
}

.alerts-box > summary::-webkit-details-marker {
  display: none;
}

.alerts-box > summary::before {
  content: '▸';
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: var(--accent);
  transition: transform 0.15s ease;
}

.alerts-box[open] > summary::before {
  transform: rotate(90deg);
}

.alerts-list {
  padding: 6px 10px 10px;
  border-top: 1px solid #295c8f66;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
}

.alert-item {
  font-size: 0.84rem;
  line-height: 1.4;
  padding: 5px 8px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: #12304fbb;
  border-left: 3px solid var(--line);
}

.alert-item.bad {
  border-left-color: var(--bad);
}

.alert-item.w {
  border-left-color: var(--accent);
}

.alert-pill {
  display: inline-block;
  margin-right: 5px;
  padding: 1px 5px;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  border-radius: 4px;
  border: 1px solid currentColor;
}

.alert-pill.bad {
  color: var(--bad);
}

.alert-pill.w {
  color: var(--accent);
}

.alert-clear {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.84rem;
  color: var(--ok);
}

.m {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 118px 1fr 56px;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 3px 8px;
  margin-top: 8px;
}

.m.sub {
  margin-top: 6px;
  padding-left: 10px;
  border-left: 2px solid #3c78b566;
  opacity: 0.95;
}

.m i {
  height: 10px;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: #0b2038;
  border-radius: 5px;
}

.m u {
  display: block;
  height: 100%;
  transition: width 0.25s ease, background-color 0.25s ease;
}

.ok u { background: var(--ok); }
.w u { background: var(--accent); }
.bad u { background: var(--bad); }

.m b {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  text-align: right;
}

b.ok { color: var(--ok); }
b.w { color: var(--accent); }
b.bad { color: var(--bad); }

.m em {
  grid-column: 2 / 4;
  font-style: normal;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  color: var(--muted);
}

.why {
  grid-column: 1 / 4;
  margin: 3px 0 2px;
  padding: 5px 8px;
  font-size: 0.84rem;
  line-height: 1.4;
  color: #dbe8f5;
  background: #12304f88;
  border-radius: 5px;
}

.m span b,
.resource-number {
  color: var(--accent);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.chk {
  margin: 5px 0;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
}

.chk.ok { color: var(--ok); }
.chk.w { color: var(--accent); }
.chk.bad { color: var(--bad); }

.fl3 {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) clamp(250px, 24vw, 340px);
  gap: 16px;
}

#flv {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  height: calc(100vh - 140px);
  min-height: 520px;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: linear-gradient(#0a1b3099, #14375a99);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 12px;
}

.flc {
  position: relative;
  width: 520px;
  height: 540px;
}

.flc .pt {
  pointer-events: none;
}

.flc .plume {
  opacity: 0;
}

.flc.fly .plume {
  opacity: 1;
}

.flc.orbit {
  animation: orbitBob 3s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.flc.orbit .plume {
  opacity: 0;
}

@keyframes orbitBob {
  50% { transform: translateY(-8px); }
}

.flc.boom {
  animation: boom 0.8s forwards;
}

@keyframes boom {
  50% { transform: scale(1.2) rotate(6deg); filter: brightness(3); }
  to { transform: scale(0.2); opacity: 0; }
}

#log p {
  margin: 8px 0;
}

#log .bad { color: var(--bad); }
#log .ok { color: var(--ok); }

#ch {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
  margin: 10px 0;
}

@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  #b3,
  .fl3 {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  .fl3 .box {
    max-height: 40vh;
  }
  #pal,
  #mt {
    max-height: none;
  }
  #cv {
    height: 420px;
    min-height: 360px;
  }
  #flv {
    height: min(66vh, 560px);
    min-height: 380px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
  #cv {
    height: 360px;
    min-height: 320px;
  }
  .m {
    grid-template-columns: 102px 1fr 48px;
  }
}

/* Sun mission: the dive sequence heats the whole launch view */
#flv.sunhit {
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% -10%, #fff3b0, #ffb347 25%, #ff5a1f 55%, #3a0d05) !important;
  transition: background 3s;
}

.flc.burn {
  filter: sepia(1) saturate(8) brightness(1.5);
  transition: filter 1.5s;
}

/* ---- Stage 3 flight view: canvas, HUD and the manual burn panel ---- */
#flcv {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}

/* The camera moves this wrapper (see placeCraftDom in renderer.js). The rocket picture sits inside it. */
#flcw {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  z-index: 1;
  width: 520px;
  height: 540px;
  pointer-events: none;
  will-change: transform, opacity;
}

/* The flight window is the main focus; the log beside it is secondary. */
.fl3 .box {
  max-height: calc(100vh - 140px);
  min-height: 0;
  overflow-y: auto;
}

.fl3 .box h2 {
  margin: 0 0 6px;
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: var(--muted);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
}

#fnext {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 14px;
  left: 50%;
  z-index: 3;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
}

.flc.gone {
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: transform 4.5s ease-in, opacity 0.6s;
}

#flhud {
  position: absolute;
  top: 10px;
  left: 12px;
  z-index: 2;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 2px;
  padding: 6px 10px;
  max-width: calc(100% - 170px);
  pointer-events: none;
  background: rgba(8, 22, 40, 0.7);
  border-radius: 8px;
  text-shadow: 0 1px 3px #000;
}

#flhud .flph {
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--accent);
}

#flhud .flday {
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: var(--muted);
}

#fskip {
  position: absolute;
  top: 10px;
  right: 10px;
  z-index: 3;
}

#burn {
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  bottom: 12px;
  z-index: 3;
  width: min(560px, calc(100% - 24px));
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  padding: 12px 14px;
  background: rgba(8, 22, 40, 0.93);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 12px;
}

#burntxt {
  margin: 0 0 8px;
}

#burngauge {
  position: relative;
  height: 30px;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: #0a1b30;
  border: 2px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 15px;
}

#burnzone {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  z-index: 2;
  background: rgba(127, 227, 184, 0.28);
  border-right: 2px solid var(--ok);
  border-left: 2px solid var(--ok);
}

#burnmark {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  z-index: 2;
  width: 2px;
  margin-left: -1px;
  background: var(--ok);
}

#burnfill {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  width: 0;
  height: 100%;
  background: var(--accent);
}

#burnfill.in {
  background: var(--ok);
}

#burnstate {
  min-height: 1.5em;
  margin: 8px 0;
  font-weight: 700;
}

#burn .row {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
}

/* .go adds a top margin for normal pages; inside the burn panel it would make the buttons uneven. */
#burn .row button {
  margin-top: 0;
}

#burnbtn {
  min-width: 160px;
  touch-action: none;
  user-select: none;
  -webkit-user-select: none;
}

/* Small screens: give the map room above the burn panel while the panel is open */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  #flv.burning {
    height: max(600px, 78vh);
  }
}

<!-- File: index.html
  Owner: Person B (Saurav)
  AI-assisted: YES — Gemini, 2026-11-15. Reviewed by a human:YES Reviewd by Person C (Yochan).
  Sources used: SPACEAPPS_CHALLENGE

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>APOGEE — Space Mission Design Game</title> 
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="./css/variables.css" />
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="./css/base.css" />
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="./css/components.css" />
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="./css/pages/dashboard.css" />
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="./css/pages/simulation.css" />
</head>
<body>
  <video id="bg" muted loop playsinline></video>

  <header>
    <a href="./index.html" class="home-link" id="brand-home" aria-label="Go to APOGEE home">
      <h1 id="hn"></h1>
    </a>
    <nav id="nav" aria-label="Mission stages"></nav>
    <button type="button" id="car"></button>
    <div class="audio-control" role="group" aria-label="Audio controls">
      <button type="button" id="mute" class="sound-on">Sound: on</button>
      <input type="range" id="vol" min="0" max="100" value="75" aria-label="Master volume" title="Master volume (75%)" />
    </div>
    <button type="button" id="copy">Share / Load code</button>
    <button type="button" id="hp">How to play</button>
  </header>

  <main id="app">
    <section class="st" id="s1" aria-label="Stage 1: Objective"></section>
    <section class="st" id="s2" aria-label="Stage 2: Spacecraft Builder"></section>
    <section class="st" id="s3" aria-label="Stage 3: Launch Simulation"></section>
    <section class="st" id="s4" aria-label="Stage 4: Post-Mission Report"></section>
  </main>

  <div id="title" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="tt">
    <div class="tbox">
      <img class="trk" src="assets/launcher_heavy.svg" alt="Heavy launch vehicle illustration" />
      <img class="tmars" src="assets/dest_mars.svg" alt="Planet destination illustration" />
      <h1 id="tt"></h1>
      <p id="tg"></p>
      <div class="row">
        <button type="button" id="start">Start mission</button>
        <button type="button" id="demo-ok">Quick Demo (Passing)</button>
        <button type="button" id="demo-fail">Try a Failing Design</button>
        <button type="button" id="hp2">How to play</button>
      </div>
      <p id="cr"></p>
      <small id="title-disclaimer"></small>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div id="help" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="help-title" hidden>
    <div class="box modal-box" id="help-body"></div>
  </div>

  <div id="rev" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" hidden></div>
  <div id="toast" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></div>
  <img id="gh" hidden alt="" />

  <script type="module" src="./js/main.js"></script>
</body>
</html>

/* File: js/api/nasaService.js
 * Owner: Person A (Ashmin)
 * AI-assisted: YES — Gemini, 2026-11-15. Reviewed by a human: YES Reviewd by Person C (Yochan)
 * Sources used: SPACEAPPS_CHALLENGE
 */
import { API_CONFIG } from '../config.js';
import { DATA } from './mockData.js';

const CACHE_KEY = 'apogeeNasaDonkiCache_v2';
const CACHE_TTL_MS = 30 * 60 * 1000;

function formatIsoDate(dateObj) {
  return dateObj.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

function readCachedWeather() {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage[CACHE_KEY];
    if (!raw) return null;
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (parsed && Date.now() - parsed.ts < CACHE_TTL_MS && parsed.spaceWeather) {
      return parsed.spaceWeather;
    }
  } catch {}
  return null;
}

function writeCachedWeather(spaceWeather) {
  try {
    localStorage[CACHE_KEY] = JSON.stringify({ ts: Date.now(), spaceWeather });
  } catch {}
}

/**
 * Fetches live space weather (Solar Flares & Coronal Mass Ejections) from NASA's
 * public DONKI API over a 30-day window with caching, timeout, and offline fallback.
 */
export async function fetchMissionReferenceData() {
  const defaultSpaceWeather = {
    isLive: false,
    flareClass: 'M1.4 (Baseline)',
    flareCount: 3,
    cmeCount: 2,
    stormLevel: 'Moderate',
    radiationMultiplier: 1.0,
    summary: 'Solar wind & flare baseline (offline fallback — check internet connection for live NASA DONKI telemetry).',
    src: 'SIMPLIFIED_FOR_GAMEPLAY'
  };

  if (!API_CONFIG.enableLiveFetch) {
    return { sourceMode: 'Offline sample', data: DATA, spaceWeather: defaultSpaceWeather };
  }

  const cached = readCachedWeather();
  if (cached) {
    return { sourceMode: 'Live NASA data', data: DATA, spaceWeather: cached };
  }

  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), API_CONFIG.timeoutMs);

  try {
    const end = new Date();
    const start = new Date(end.getTime() - 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    const rangeQuery = `&startDate=${formatIsoDate(start)}&endDate=${formatIsoDate(end)}`;

    const [flrRes, cmeRes] = await Promise.all([
      fetch(`${API_CONFIG.donkiFlareEndpoint}${rangeQuery}`, { signal: controller.signal }),
      fetch(`${API_CONFIG.donkiCmeEndpoint}${rangeQuery}`, { signal: controller.signal })
    ]);
    clearTimeout(timeoutId);

    if (!flrRes.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${flrRes.status}`);
    const flares = await flrRes.json();
    const cmes = cmeRes.ok ? await cmeRes.json() : [];

    const flareList = Array.isArray(flares) ? flares : [];
    const cmeList = Array.isArray(cmes) ? cmes : [];

    let peakClass = 'C1.0';
    let peakRank = 2;
    flareList.forEach(f => {
      const cls = String(f.classType || '').toUpperCase();
      const rank = cls.startsWith('X') ? 4 : cls.startsWith('M') ? 3 : cls.startsWith('C') ? 2 : 1;
      if (rank >= peakRank && cls) {
        peakRank = rank;
        peakClass = cls;
      }
    });

    const stormLevel = peakRank >= 4 ? `Severe (${peakClass})` : peakRank === 3 ? `Elevated (${peakClass})` : `Nominal (${peakClass})`;
    const radiationMultiplier = peakRank >= 4 ? 1.15 : peakRank === 3 ? 1.05 : 0.96;

    const spaceWeather = {
      isLive: true,
      flareClass: peakClass,
      flareCount: flareList.length,
      cmeCount: cmeList.length,
      stormLevel,
      radiationMultiplier,
      summary: `Live NASA DONKI (30-day telemetry): ${flareList.length} solar flares (peak ${peakClass}) & ${cmeList.length} CMEs tracked.`,
      src: 'NASA DONKI Space Weather API'
    };

    writeCachedWeather(spaceWeather);
    return { sourceMode: 'Live NASA data', data: DATA, spaceWeather };
  } catch {
    clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    return { sourceMode: 'Offline sample', data: DATA, spaceWeather: defaultSpaceWeather };
  }
}

    <p><b>Spacecraft assembly:</b> Click a part on the left palette (or drag it onto a glowing attachment node) to build your stack. Select any placed part to Rotate (<code>R</code>), Flip (<code>F</code>), or Delete.</p>
    <p><b>Live NASA space weather:</b> APOGEE fetches recent solar flare &amp; CME telemetry from NASA DONKI to set radiation conditions and mid-flight anomalies.</p>
    <p><b>Center of mass &amp; thrust:</b> Keep the yellow Center of Mass aligned with the dashed green engine thrust line so the rocket does not tumble.</p>
    <p><b>Six resources:</b> Mass, Power, Budget, Data, Comms, and Time. Green = healthy reserve, Amber = thin reserve, Red = critical failure.</p>
    <p><b>Career progression:</b> Earth, the Moon, and Mars start open. Safe arrivals unlock Venus, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Mercury, and the Sun. Progress saves automatically in your browser.</p>
    <p><b>Manual burns:</b> During launch you can fly two burns yourself: the departure burn that sends you on your way, and the orbit insertion burn when you arrive. Hold the button (or Space) and let go inside the green zone. The insertion zone is narrower, so it is harder. A clean pair adds up to 6% extra science in total. Press Auto-pilot to skip one burn, or Auto-pilot all burns to skip both: no bonus, no penalty. The result never depends on luck.</p>
    <p><b>How a mission ends:</b> <b>Mission accomplished</b> means you reached orbit <i>and</i> returned at least the baseline science. <b>Partial success</b> means you reached orbit and met the minimum (threshold) science, but fell short of the baseline. <b>Mission failed</b> means you never arrived, or arrived but returned less than the minimum. Only Mission accomplished plays the victory music.</p>
    <p><b>Stars:</b> 1&#9733; partial success, 2&#9733; meet baseline science, 3&#9733; earn all four role sign-offs and spend under 85% of budget.</p>

/* File: js/core/career.js
 * Owner: ported from the Apogee-temp-asmin feature branch (lib/career.js, v3.2)
 * AI-assisted: YES — Claude, 2026-11-14; Gemini, 2026-11-15. Reviewed by a human: YES Reviewd by Person C (Yochan)
 * Sources used: none (game design, not NASA data)
 */
import { DATA } from '../api/mockData.js';
import { CONTENT } from '../content.js';

export const HOME_IDS = ['earth', 'moon', 'mars'];

/* Engaging, paced unlock chain so players unlock new worlds steadily without tedious grinding */
export const GATES = [
  { id: 'venus', lv: 2, need: [['earth', 1], ['moon', 1]], title: 'Orbital Cadet' },
  { id: 'jupiter', lv: 4, need: [['mars', 1], ['venus', 1]], title: 'Deep-Space Navigator' },
  { id: 'saturn', lv: 6, need: [['jupiter', 1]], title: 'Ring Rider' },
  { id: 'uranus', lv: 8, need: [['saturn', 1, 1]], title: 'Ice Voyager' },
  { id: 'neptune', lv: 10, need: [['uranus', 1, 1]], title: 'Edge Walker' },
  { id: 'mercury', lv: 12, need: [['neptune', 1, 1]], title: 'Fire Walker' },
  { id: 'sun', lv: 14, need: [['mercury', 1, 1]], title: 'Master of the Solar System' }
];

const GRAND_TOUR = ['mercury', 'venus', 'earth', 'mars', 'jupiter', 'saturn', 'uranus', 'neptune'];
const STORAGE_KEY = 'apogeeCareer';
const emptyCareer = () => ({ arr: {}, good: {}, lost: 0, tot: 0, un: [], ach: {}, streak: 0, dev: false });

let career = emptyCareer();
try {
  const parsed = JSON.parse(localStorage[STORAGE_KEY] || '{}');
  if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object') {
    if ('god' in parsed && !('dev' in parsed)) {
      parsed.dev = !!parsed.god;
    }
    delete parsed.god;
    Object.assign(career, parsed);
  }
} catch {
  career = emptyCareer();
}

const saveCareer = () => {
  try {
    localStorage[STORAGE_KEY] = JSON.stringify(career);
  } catch {}
};

export const ACHIEVEMENTS = [
  { id: 'first', n: 'First Light', t: 'Make your first safe arrival.', test: x => x.ok },
  { id: 'star3', n: 'Flawless', t: 'Earn 3 stars on a mission.', test: x => x.st >= 3 },
  { id: 'thrift', n: 'Penny Pincher', t: 'Succeed while spending under 65% of the budget.', test: x => x.out === 'success' && x.d.cost <= x.C.cap * 0.65 },
  { id: 'home', n: 'Home Turf', t: 'Arrive safely at Earth, the Moon and Mars.', test: () => HOME_IDS.every(h => career.arr[h] > 0) },
  { id: 'nuke', n: 'Nuclear Option', t: 'Arrive safely using a nuclear thermal engine.', test: x => x.ok && x.d.E.patch === 'nuc' },
  { id: 'ion', n: 'Slow and Steady', t: 'Arrive safely using an ion engine.', test: x => x.ok && x.d.E.patch === 'ion' },
  { id: 'rtg', n: 'Atomic Battery', t: 'Arrive safely with a radioisotope generator aboard.', test: x => x.ok && x.rtg },
  { id: 'book', n: 'By the Book', t: 'Succeed under the NASA 35% margin policy.', test: x => x.out === 'success' && x.hard },
  { id: 'phoenix', n: 'Phoenix', t: 'Succeed right after losing a mission.', test: x => x.ok && x.wasLost },
  { id: 'learn', n: 'Learning the Hard Way', t: 'Lose 3 missions. Every engineer iterates.', test: () => career.lost >= 3 },
  { id: 'vet', n: 'Veteran', t: 'Make 8 safe arrivals.', test: () => career.tot >= 8 },
  { id: 'dir', n: 'Flight Director', t: 'Make 15 safe arrivals.', test: () => career.tot >= 15 },
  { id: 'tour', n: 'Grand Tour', t: 'Arrive safely at all eight planets.', test: () => GRAND_TOUR.every(h => career.arr[h] > 0) },
  { id: 'icarus', n: 'Icarus', t: 'Fly toward the Sun. It did not end well.', test: x => !!x.C.doom }
];

export const getCareer = () => career;
export const isDeveloperMode = () => !!career.dev;
export const isContractOpen = id => isDeveloperMode() || HOME_IDS.includes(id) || career.un.includes(id);

export function toggleDeveloperMode() {
  career.dev = !career.dev;
  saveCareer();
  return career.dev;
}

export const getContractSortKey = contract =>
  isContractOpen(contract.id) ? contract.ord : 100 + GATES.findIndex(g => g.id === contract.id);

export const getPlanetName = id => CONTENT.planetInfo[id].name.replace(/^the /, '');

const getTopGate = () => (isDeveloperMode() ? GATES[GATES.length - 1] : GATES.filter(g => career.un.includes(g.id)).pop());
export const getCareerLevel = () => (getTopGate() ? getTopGate().lv : 0);
export const getCareerRank = () => (isDeveloperMode() ? 'Developer Mode (All Maps)' : getTopGate() ? getTopGate().title : 'Launch Pad Rookie');
export const getNextGate = () => (isDeveloperMode() ? null : GATES.find(g => !career.un.includes(g.id)));
export const getCareerButtonLabel = () => `Career: Level ${getCareerLevel()} - ${getCareerRank()}`;

const countArrivals = (id, good) => (good ? career.good : career.arr)[id] || 0;

export const describeGateNeed = gate =>
  gate.need.map(([id, count, good]) => {
    const kind = good ? 'good' : 'safe';
    const plural = count > 1 ? 's' : '';
    const suffix = good ? ' (science above threshold)' : '';
    return `${count} ${kind} arrival${plural} at ${getPlanetName(id)}${suffix} (${Math.min(count, countArrivals(id, good))}/${count})`;
  }).join(', ');

export const getLockInfo = contract => {
  const gate = GATES.find(g => g.id === contract.id);
  return gate ? { level: gate.lv, need: describeGateNeed(gate) } : null;
};

export function recordMission({ out, C, d, st, rtg, sci, hard }) {
  const ok = out !== 'lost';
  const news = [];
  const wasLost = career.streak > 0;

  if (ok) {
    career.arr[C.id] = (career.arr[C.id] || 0) + 1;
    career.tot++;
    career.streak = 0;
    if ((sci || 0) >= C.thr) career.good[C.id] = (career.good[C.id] || 0) + 1;
  } else {
    career.lost++;
    career.streak++;
  }

  for (let changed = true; changed;) {
    changed = false;
    GATES.forEach(gate => {
      const met = gate.need.every(([id, count, good]) => countArrivals(id, good) >= count);
      if (!career.un.includes(gate.id) && met) {
        career.un.push(gate.id);
        news.push({ k: 'lv', lv: gate.lv, title: gate.title, planet: getPlanetName(gate.id) });
        changed = true;
      }
    });
  }

  const context = { ok, out, C, d, st, rtg, wasLost, hard: !!hard };
  ACHIEVEMENTS.forEach(a => {
    if (!career.ach[a.id] && a.test(context)) {
      career.ach[a.id] = 1;
      news.push({ k: 'ach', n: a.n, t: a.t });
    }
  });

  saveCareer();
  return news;
}

export function resetCareer() {
  career = emptyCareer();
  saveCareer();
}

export const getUngatedDestinations = () =>
  DATA.contracts.filter(c => !HOME_IDS.includes(c.id) && !GATES.some(g => g.id === c.id)).map(c => c.id);

import { DATA } from '../api/mockData.js';
import { CONTENT } from '../content.js';
import { getFeasibility } from './planets.js';
import { PART_DIMENSIONS, ATTACHMENT_NODES, MAX_PARTS, DEFAULT_SEED } from '../config.js';
import {
  appState,
  getNodeCategory,
  getDimensionKey,
  saveUndoSnapshot
} from './state.js';

export function createSeededRng(seed = DEFAULT_SEED) {
  let state = seed >>> 0;
  return function nextRandom() {
    state += 0x6d2b79f5;
    let t = Math.imul(state ^ (state >>> 15), 1 | state);
    t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t);
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}

/* ---- Pure Geometry & Node Graph Helpers ---- */

export const findPartByUid = uid => appState.mission.parts.find(p => p.u === uid);
export const getPartSize = part => PART_DIMENSIONS[getDimensionKey(part.id)];
export const isStackNode = nodeName => ['top', 'bottom', 'base'].includes(nodeName);

export function getNodeOffset(part, nodeName) {
  const [width, height] = getPartSize(part);
  const node = ATTACHMENT_NODES[getNodeCategory(part.id)].find(n => n[0] === nodeName);
  let x = (node[1] - 0.5) * width;
  let y = (node[2] - 0.5) * height;
  if (part.flip) x = -x;

  const rad = (part.rot * Math.PI) / 180;
  const cos = Math.cos(rad);
  const sin = Math.sin(rad);
  return [x * cos - y * sin, x * sin + y * cos];
}

export function getNodeWorldPosition(part, nodeName) {
  const [offsetX, offsetY] = getNodeOffset(part, nodeName);
  return [part.x + offsetX, part.y + offsetY];
}

export function getSubtreeUids(rootUid) {
  const uids = [rootUid];
  for (let i = 0; i < uids.length; i++) {
    appState.mission.parts.forEach(part => {
      if (part.par === uids[i]) uids.push(part.u);
    });
  }
  return uids;
}

export function getOccupiedNodes() {
  const occupied = new Set();
  appState.mission.parts.forEach(part => {
    if (part.par != null) {
      occupied.add(`${part.par}:${part.pn}`);
      occupied.add(`${part.u}:${part.cn}`);
    }
  });
  return occupied;
}

export function getConnectedPartUids() {
  const connected = new Set();
  appState.mission.parts.forEach(part => {
    let current = part;
    let depth = 0;
    while (current && current.par != null && depth++ < 80) {
      current = findPartByUid(current.par);
    }
    if (current && getNodeCategory(current.id) === 'bus') {
      connected.add(part.u);
    }
  });
  return connected;
}

/* ---- Spacecraft Assembly Operations ---- */

export function createPartInstance(partId, x, y) {
  const part = {
    u: appState.mission.nu++,
    id: partId,
    x,
    y,
    rot: 0,
    flip: 0,
    par: null
  };
  appState.mission.parts.push(part);
  return part;
}

export function movePartSubtree(rootUid, deltaX, deltaY) {
  getSubtreeUids(rootUid).forEach(uid => {
    const part = findPartByUid(uid);
    part.x += deltaX;
    part.y += deltaY;
  });
}

export function deletePartSubtree(rootUid) {
  const toDelete = new Set(getSubtreeUids(rootUid));
  appState.mission.parts = appState.mission.parts.filter(part => !toDelete.has(part.u));
}

export function attachParts(child, childNode, host, hostNode) {
  const hasChildren = appState.mission.parts.some(p => p.par === child.u);
  if (!isStackNode(childNode) && !isStackNode(hostNode) && !hasChildren) {
    child.rot = 0;
    child.flip = hostNode.startsWith('L') ? 1 : 0;
  }

  const [hostX, hostY] = getNodeWorldPosition(host, hostNode);
  const [childOffsetX, childOffsetY] = getNodeOffset(child, childNode);
  movePartSubtree(child.u, hostX - childOffsetX - child.x, hostY - childOffsetY - child.y);

  child.par = host.u;
  child.cn = childNode;
  child.pn = hostNode;
}

export function mirrorPartIfEnabled(childPart) {
  const host = findPartByUid(childPart.par);
  if (
    !appState.mission.mirror ||
    isStackNode(childPart.pn) ||
    host.rot !== 0 ||
    DATA.parts[childPart.id].g === 'sci' ||
    appState.mission.parts.length >= MAX_PARTS
  ) {
    return;
  }

  const oppositeSide = childPart.pn.startsWith('L') ? 'R' : 'L';
  const oppositeNode = oppositeSide + childPart.pn.slice(1);
  if (getOccupiedNodes().has(`${host.u}:${oppositeNode}`)) return;

  const twinPart = createPartInstance(childPart.id, 0, 0);
  attachParts(twinPart, childPart.cn, host, oppositeNode);
}

/**
 * Builds the starter spacecraft centered at (480, 495) of the 960x1100 world canvas,
 * omitting the communications antenna so players attach one before launching.
 */
export function buildStarterSpacecraft() {
  appState.mission.parts = [];
  appState.mission.nu = 1;

  const centerX = 480;
  const bus = createPartInstance('bus_rad', centerX, 395);
  const tank = createPartInstance('tank', centerX, 515);
  const engine = createPartInstance('chem', centerX, 625);

  attachParts(tank, 'top', bus, 'bottom');
  attachParts(engine, 'top', tank, 'bottom');

  const mountPart = (partId, host, hostNode) => {
    const part = createPartInstance(partId, 0, 0);
    const childNode = getNodeCategory(partId) === 'ant' ? 'base' : 'in';
    attachParts(part, childNode, host, hostNode);
    return part;
  };

  mirrorPartIfEnabled(mountPart('sol_s', bus, 'R1'));
  mountPart('i_cam', bus, 'R2');
  mountPart('bat', tank, 'R1');
}

export function buildFailingDemoSpacecraft() {
  // A design that passes every launch check but cannot be flown: a heavy radar craft with one tank is
  // short on delta-v for a low Mars orbit, so the flight (and the debrief) explains why it fails.
  appState.mission.ci = 2;
  appState.mission.oi = 0;
  appState.mission.L = 'medium';
  appState.mission.hard = 0;
  appState.mission.parts = [];
  appState.mission.nu = 1;

  const centerX = 480;
  const bus = createPartInstance('bus_red', centerX, 395);
  const tank = createPartInstance('tank', centerX, 515);
  const engine = createPartInstance('chem', centerX, 625);

  attachParts(tank, 'top', bus, 'bottom');
  attachParts(engine, 'top', tank, 'bottom');

  const mountPart = (partId, host, hostNode) => {
    const part = createPartInstance(partId, 0, 0);
    attachParts(part, 'in', host, hostNode);
    return part;
  };

  mountPart('sol_l', bus, 'L1');
  mountPart('sol_l', bus, 'R1');
  mountPart('i_radar', bus, 'R2');
  mountPart('bat', tank, 'R1');
  autoAttachPart('ant_hg');
}

export function buildDeveloperPrebuilt(prebuiltId) {
  const spec = DEVELOPER_PREBUILTS.find(p => p.id === prebuiltId);
  if (!spec) return null;

  const contractIndex = DATA.contracts.findIndex(c => c.id === spec.contractId);
  if (contractIndex === -1) return null;

  appState.mission.ci = contractIndex;
  appState.mission.oi = spec.oi;
  appState.mission.L = spec.launcher;
  appState.mission.hard = spec.hard;
  appState.mission.locked = false;
  appState.mission.parts = [];
  appState.mission.nu = 1;

  const centerX = 480;
  const bus = createPartInstance(spec.bus, centerX, 340);
  const tanks = [];
  let prevHost = bus;

  for (let i = 0; i < spec.tanks; i++) {
    const tank = createPartInstance('tank', centerX, 460 + i * 120);
    attachParts(tank, 'top', prevHost, 'bottom');
    tanks.push(tank);
    prevHost = tank;
  }

  const engine = createPartInstance(spec.engine, centerX, 460 + spec.tanks * 120);
  attachParts(engine, 'top', prevHost, 'bottom');

  if (spec.ant) {
    const ant = createPartInstance(spec.ant, 0, 0);
    attachParts(ant, 'base', bus, 'top');
  }

  const resolveHost = ref => (ref === 'bus' ? bus : tanks[ref] || bus);

  (spec.pairs || []).forEach(([partId, hostRef, tier]) => {
    const host = resolveHost(hostRef);
    const rightPart = createPartInstance(partId, 0, 0);
    attachParts(rightPart, 'in', host, `R${tier}`);
    const leftPart = createPartInstance(partId, 0, 0);
    attachParts(leftPart, 'in', host, `L${tier}`);
  });

  (spec.singles || []).forEach(([partId, hostRef, nodeName]) => {
    const host = resolveHost(hostRef);
    const part = createPartInstance(partId, 0, 0);
    attachParts(part, 'in', host, nodeName);
  });

  return spec;
}

export function autoAttachPart(partId) {
  const category = getNodeCategory(partId);
  const connected = getConnectedPartUids();
  const hosts = appState.mission.parts
    .filter(p => connected.has(p.u))
    .sort((a, b) => a.y - b.y);
  const bus = appState.mission.parts.find(p => getNodeCategory(p.id) === 'bus');

  if (category === 'bus') {
    if (bus) {
      bus.id = partId;
    } else {
      saveUndoSnapshot();
      createPartInstance(partId, 480, 395);
    }
    return { ok: true };
  }

  if (!bus) {
    return { ok: false, message: 'Start with a spacecraft bus: it is the root everything bolts onto.' };
  }
  if (appState.mission.parts.length >= MAX_PARTS) {
    return { ok: false, message: `Part limit reached (${MAX_PARTS}).` };
  }

  const occupied = getOccupiedNodes();
  const isNodeFree = (host, node) => !occupied.has(`${host.u}:${node}`);
  const hasNode = (host, node) => ATTACHMENT_NODES[getNodeCategory(host.id)].some(n => n[0] === node);

  saveUndoSnapshot();

  if (category === 'eng') {
    const existingEngine = appState.mission.parts.find(p => getNodeCategory(p.id) === 'eng');
    if (existingEngine) {
      existingEngine.id = partId;
      if (existingEngine.par != null) {
        attachParts(existingEngine, 'top', findPartByUid(existingEngine.par), existingEngine.pn);
      }
      return { ok: true };
    }
    const bottomHost = [...hosts].reverse().find(h => hasNode(h, 'bottom') && isNodeFree(h, 'bottom'));
    if (!bottomHost) return { ok: false, message: 'Nothing to bolt an engine under.' };
    attachParts(createPartInstance(partId, 0, 0), 'top', bottomHost, 'bottom');
    return { ok: true };
  }

  if (category === 'tank') {
    const lowestStack = [...hosts].reverse().find(h => ['bus', 'tank'].includes(getNodeCategory(h.id)));
    const attachedBottom = appState.mission.parts.find(p => p.par === lowestStack.u && p.pn === 'bottom');
    const newTank = createPartInstance('tank', 0, 0);

    if (attachedBottom) {
      attachedBottom.par = null;
      attachParts(newTank, 'top', lowestStack, 'bottom');
      attachParts(attachedBottom, attachedBottom.cn, newTank, 'bottom');
    } else {
      attachParts(newTank, 'top', lowestStack, 'bottom');
    }
    return { ok: true };
  }

  if (category === 'ant') {
    const topHost = hosts.find(h => ['bus', 'tank'].includes(getNodeCategory(h.id)) && isNodeFree(h, 'top'));
    if (!topHost) return { ok: false, message: 'No free mounting point on top. Move something first.' };
    attachParts(createPartInstance(partId, 0, 0), 'base', topHost, 'top');
    return { ok: true };
  }

  for (const host of hosts) {
    for (const sideNode of ['R1', 'L1', 'R2', 'L2']) {
      if (hasNode(host, sideNode) && isNodeFree(host, sideNode)) {
        const part = createPartInstance(partId, 0, 0);
        attachParts(part, 'in', host, sideNode);
        mirrorPartIfEnabled(part);
        return { ok: true };
      }
    }
  }

  return { ok: false, message: 'No free mounting point. Drag a part off the ship, or add a tank for more mounts.' };
}

/* ---- Pure Physics & Engineering Evaluation ---- */

export function calculateTelemetry(missionInput = appState.mission) {
  const threshold = missionInput.hard ? DATA.marginPolicies.hard.v : DATA.marginPolicies.easy.v;
  appState.marginThreshold = threshold;

  const contract = DATA.contracts[missionInput.ci];
  const orbit = contract.orbits[missionInput.oi];
  const launcher = DATA.launchers[missionInput.L];
  const tankSpec = DATA.tank;
  const weather = appState.spaceWeather;

  const connectedUids = getConnectedPartUids();
  const connectedParts = missionInput.parts.filter(p => connectedUids.has(p.u));

  const busPart = connectedParts.find(p => getNodeCategory(p.id) === 'bus');
  const engineParts = connectedParts.filter(p => getNodeCategory(p.id) === 'eng');

  const busSpec = DATA.parts[busPart ? busPart.id : 'bus_std'];
  const engineSpec = DATA.engines[engineParts[0] ? engineParts[0].id : 'chem'];

  const telemetry = {
    C: contract,
    O: orbit,
    B: busSpec,
    E: engineSpec,
    L: launcher,
    dry: busSpec.m + engineParts.length * engineSpec.m,
    load: busSpec.pw,
    gen: 0,
    rg: 0,
    wh: 0,
    mb: 0,
    gb: DATA.constants.baseStorageGb.value,
    rec: 0,
    data: 0,
    sci: 0,
    tk: 0,
    cost: busSpec.c + engineParts.length * engineSpec.c + launcher.c
  };

  let propellantMass = 0;
  let weightedX = 0;
  let weightedY = 0;
  let totalMass = 0;
  const seenInstruments = {};

  connectedParts.forEach(part => {
    let partMass = 0;
    const category = getNodeCategory(part.id);

    if (part.id === 'tank') {
      telemetry.tk++;
      telemetry.dry += tankSpec.dry;
      telemetry.cost += tankSpec.c;
      propellantMass += tankSpec.prop;
      partMass = tankSpec.dry + tankSpec.prop;
    } else if (category === 'eng') {
      partMass = engineSpec.m;
    } else if (category === 'bus') {
      partMass = busSpec.m;
    } else {
      const spec = DATA.parts[part.id];
      partMass = spec.m;
      telemetry.dry += spec.m;
      telemetry.cost += spec.c;
      telemetry.load += spec.pw || 0;
      if (spec.rtg) telemetry.rg += spec.gen || 0;
      else telemetry.gen += spec.gen || 0;
      telemetry.wh += spec.wh || 0;
      telemetry.mb = Math.max(telemetry.mb, spec.mb || 0);

      if (spec.gb) {
        telemetry.gb += spec.gb;
        telemetry.rec++;
      }
      telemetry.data += spec.data || 0;
      if (spec.sci) {
        telemetry.sci += spec.sci * (seenInstruments[part.id] ? 0.25 : 1);
        seenInstruments[part.id] = true;
      }
    }

    totalMass += partMass;
    weightedX += partMass * part.x;
    weightedY += partMass * part.y;
  });

  telemetry.comx = totalMass ? weightedX / totalMass : 0;
  telemetry.comy = totalMass ? weightedY / totalMass : 0;
  telemetry.engx = engineParts[0] ? engineParts[0].x : telemetry.comx;
  telemetry.off = engineParts.length ? Math.abs(telemetry.comx - telemetry.engx) : 0;
  telemetry.box = connectedParts.length
    ? [Math.min(...connectedParts.map(p => p.y)) - 30, Math.max(...connectedParts.map(p => p.y)) + 80]
    : [0, 0];

  telemetry.m0 = telemetry.dry + propellantMass;
  telemetry.dv = engineSpec.isp * DATA.constants.g0.value * Math.log(telemetry.m0 / telemetry.dry);
  telemetry.sun = telemetry.gen * DATA.solarFluxFactor[contract.dest].value * (1 - orbit.ecl) + telemetry.rg;
  telemetry.ecH = orbit.ecl * orbit.per;
  telemetry.down = telemetry.mb * DATA.commsDistanceFactor[contract.dest].value * orbit.contact * 86.4;
  telemetry.days = Math.max(
    DATA.transitDaysBase[contract.dest].value * engineSpec.tf,
    engineSpec.dvDay ? (orbit.dv * 1000) / engineSpec.dvDay : 0
  );

  const radWear = orbit.rad && !busSpec.hard
    ? Math.max(0.5, 0.65 / (weather?.radiationMultiplier || 1))
    : orbit.rad > 1
      ? 0.75
      : 1;
  telemetry.baseLife = contract.life || DATA.constants.designLifeMonths.value;
  telemetry.life = telemetry.baseLife * radWear - telemetry.days / 30;

  const buildCheckRow = (name, category, used, capacity, unit, src, verified) => {
    const margin = used <= 0 ? 1 : capacity > 0 ? (capacity - used) / used : -1;
    const lesson = CONTENT.lessons[name];
    return {
      id: name.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '_'),
      category,
      n: name,
      use: used,
      cap: capacity,
      u: unit,
      mg: margin,
      pass: margin >= 0,
      severity: margin < 0 ? 'critical' : margin < threshold ? 'warning' : 'info',
      why: lesson.why,
      fix: lesson.fix,
      src,
      verified
    };
  };

  const requiredContactHours = telemetry.data
    ? (telemetry.mb ? telemetry.data / (telemetry.mb * DATA.commsDistanceFactor[contract.dest].value * 3.6) : 99)
    : 0;

  telemetry.rows = [
    buildCheckRow('Mass', 'mass', telemetry.m0, launcher.cap, 'kg', launcher.src, launcher.verified),
    buildCheckRow('Delta-v', 'launch', orbit.dv * 1000, telemetry.dv, 'm/s', orbit.src, orbit.verified),
    buildCheckRow('Power', 'power', telemetry.load, telemetry.sun, 'W', DATA.solarFluxFactor[contract.dest].src, false),
    buildCheckRow('Battery', 'power', telemetry.load * telemetry.ecH, telemetry.wh * DATA.constants.batteryDepthOfDischarge.value, 'Wh', DATA.constants.batteryDepthOfDischarge.src, false),
    buildCheckRow('Budget', 'budget', telemetry.cost, contract.cap, '$M', contract.src, contract.verified),
    buildCheckRow('Data storage', 'data', telemetry.data * (1 - orbit.contact), telemetry.gb, 'Gb', DATA.constants.baseStorageGb.src, false),
    buildCheckRow('Comms', 'comms', requiredContactHours, orbit.contact * 24, 'h/day', DATA.commsDistanceFactor[contract.dest].src, false),
    buildCheckRow('Time', 'time', contract.months, telemetry.life, 'months', weather?.isLive ? weather.src : DATA.constants.designLifeMonths.src, weather?.isLive || false)
  ];

  if (engineSpec.pw) {
    telemetry.rows.push(
      buildCheckRow('Ion power', 'power', engineSpec.pw, telemetry.gen + telemetry.rg, 'W', engineSpec.src, engineSpec.verified)
    );
  }

  const getRow = name => telemetry.rows.find(r => r.n === name);
  telemetry.g = getRow;

  const flightModel = DATA.flightModel;
  const floatingCount = missionInput.parts.length - connectedParts.length;
  const isEngineValid = busPart && engineParts.length === 1 && engineParts[0].rot === 0 && engineParts[0].y > busPart.y;

  telemetry.checks = [
    {
      t: 'A spacecraft bus is the root of the ship',
      st: busPart ? 2 : 0,
      why: 'Everything must bolt onto the bus.',
      fix: 'Add a spacecraft bus from the Structure list.'
    },
    {
      t: 'Exactly one engine, nozzle down, below the bus',
      st: isEngineValid ? 2 : 0,
      why: 'Rockets must apply thrust axially from the aft stack.',
      fix: 'Attach one engine facing down beneath your fuel tanks.'
    },
    {
      t: 'Every part is attached',
      st: floatingCount ? 0 : 2,
      why: `${floatingCount} part(s) are unattached (highlighted red).`,
      fix: 'Drag unattached parts onto a glowing attachment node or delete them.'
    },
    {
      t: 'Balanced: thrust line through the center of mass',
      st: telemetry.off <= flightModel.balanceGoodPx ? 2 : telemetry.off <= flightModel.balanceLimitPx ? 1 : 0,
      why: `Center of mass is ${telemetry.off.toFixed(0)} px off the thrust line (tumbles above ${flightModel.balanceLimitPx} px).`,
      fix: 'Mirror heavy parts symmetrically left and right of the centerline.'
    }
  ];

  const dataReturnRatio = telemetry.data
    ? Math.min(1, telemetry.down / telemetry.data) * (getRow('Data storage').mg < 0 ? telemetry.gb / (telemetry.data * (1 - orbit.contact)) : 1)
    : 0;

  telemetry.ret = dataReturnRatio;
  telemetry.sciF =
    telemetry.sci *
    orbit.res *
    dataReturnRatio *
    (Math.max(0, telemetry.life) / telemetry.baseLife) *
    (getRow('Power').mg < 0 ? 0.5 : 1) *
    (getRow('Battery').mg < 0 ? 0.6 : 1);

  const hasHealthyMargin = name => getRow(name).mg >= threshold;
  const isPositiveMargin = name => getRow(name).mg >= 0;

  telemetry.sign = {
    Director: isPositiveMargin('Mass') && isPositiveMargin('Budget') && isPositiveMargin('Time'),
    Engineer:
      hasHealthyMargin('Delta-v') &&
      hasHealthyMargin('Power') &&
      hasHealthyMargin('Battery') &&
      (!engineSpec.pw || hasHealthyMargin('Ion power')) &&
      telemetry.checks[3].st === 2,
    Science: telemetry.sciF >= contract.target,
    Comms: hasHealthyMargin('Comms') && hasHealthyMargin('Data storage') && telemetry.data > 0
  };
  telemetry.signed = Object.values(telemetry.sign).every(Boolean);

  telemetry.revItems = [
    ...telemetry.rows.map(r => [r.n, r.mg < 0 ? 0 : r.mg < threshold ? 1 : 2]),
    ...telemetry.checks.map(c => [c.t, c.st]),
    ['Science vs threshold goal', telemetry.sciF >= contract.target ? 2 : telemetry.sciF >= contract.thr ? 1 : 0]
  ];

  const itemCount = telemetry.revItems.length;
  const countStatus = code => telemetry.revItems.filter(item => item[1] === code).length;
  telemetry.rev = {
    n: itemCount,
    g: countStatus(2),
    y: countStatus(1),
    r: countStatus(0),
    pct: countStatus(2) / itemCount,
    pass: countStatus(2) / itemCount >= DATA.reviewThreshold.v
  };

  const marginPenalty = telemetry.rows.reduce(
    (sum, r) => (r.mg >= 0 && r.mg < threshold ? sum + (threshold - r.mg) * flightModel.amberPenaltyFactor : sum),
    0
  );
  const balancePenalty = Math.min(
    flightModel.balancePenaltyAtLimit,
    (telemetry.off / flightModel.balanceLimitPx) * flightModel.balancePenaltyAtLimit
  );
  const signOffBonus = telemetry.signed ? flightModel.signOffBonus : 0;
  const reviewPenalty = telemetry.rev.pass ? 0 : flightModel.reviewFailPenalty;
  const baseReliability = launcher.rel * busSpec.rel;
  const adjustment = -marginPenalty - balancePenalty + signOffBonus - reviewPenalty;

  telemetry.reliabilityParts = { launcher: launcher.rel, bus: busSpec.rel, adjustment };
  telemetry.reliability = Math.max(
    flightModel.reliabilityMin,
    Math.min(flightModel.reliabilityMax, baseReliability + adjustment)
  );
  telemetry.bad = telemetry.checks.slice(0, 3).find(c => c.st === 0);

  return telemetry;
}

/* ---- Deterministic Flight Resolution & Present-Day Events ---- */

export function fillTemplate(template, values = {}) {
  return template.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (match, key) => {
    const value = values[key];
    if (typeof value !== 'number') return value === undefined ? match : String(value);
    return key.endsWith('Pct') ? String(Math.round(value * 100)) : Math.round(value).toLocaleString();
  });
}

function doesEventTrigger(event, telemetry) {
  const { trigger } = event;
  if (trigger.dest !== undefined) return telemetry.C.dest === trigger.dest;
  if (trigger.minTransitDays !== undefined) return telemetry.days >= trigger.minTransitDays;
  const value = telemetry.O[trigger.orbitField];
  if (trigger.gte !== undefined && value < trigger.gte) return false;
  if (trigger.lte !== undefined && value > trigger.lte) return false;
  return true;
}

function isEventImmune(event, telemetry) {
  if (event.imm === 'hard') return !!telemetry.B.hard;
  if (event.imm === 'rec') return telemetry.rec > 0;
  return !!telemetry.B.red;
}

export function getTriggeredEvents(telemetry) {
  const weather = appState.spaceWeather;
  return DATA.events
    .filter(event => doesEventTrigger(event, telemetry))
    .map(event => {
      const immune = isEventImmune(event, telemetry);
      let factor = event.scienceFactor;
      if (!immune && event.id === 'solar_flare' && weather?.radiationMultiplier > 1) {
        factor = Math.max(0.65, +(event.scienceFactor / weather.radiationMultiplier).toFixed(2));
      }
      return {
        id: event.id,
        immune,
        scienceFactor: immune ? 1 : factor
      };
    });
}

export function scoreFlight(telemetry, outcome, science) {
  const weights = DATA.scoringWeights;
  const contract = telemetry.C;

  let stars = outcome === 'lost' ? 0 : 1;
  if (science >= contract.target) stars = 2;
  if (stars === 2 && telemetry.signed && telemetry.cost <= contract.cap * weights.threeStarBudgetFraction) stars = 3;

  const score = outcome === 'lost'
    ? 0
    : Math.round(
        (science * weights.scienceMultiplier +
          (contract.cap - telemetry.cost) * weights.budgetSavingsMultiplier +
          stars * weights.starBonus) *
          (telemetry.signed ? weights.fullSignOffMultiplier : 1) *
          telemetry.reliability
      );

  return { stars, score };
}

/**
 * One place that decides how a flight ends, so the flight, the re-score after mid-flight decisions and the
 * predicted flight can never disagree.
 *   success = science reaches the contract baseline (target)
 *   partial = science reaches the minimum (threshold) but not the baseline
 *   lost    = no science, or less than the minimum
 * The minimum is the contract threshold times DATA.flightModel.failBelowThresholdFactor.
 */
export function classifyOutcome(science, contract) {
  const minimum = contract.thr * DATA.flightModel.failBelowThresholdFactor;
  if (science >= contract.target) return 'success';
  if (science > 0 && science >= minimum) return 'partial';
  return 'lost';
}

const clamp01 = value => Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Number(value) || 0));

const BURN_ORDER = ['departure', 'insertion'];

function getBurnQuality(burns, kind) {
  return burns && burns[kind] ? clamp01(burns[kind].quality) : null;
}

export function scoreBurn(fill, kind = 'departure') {
  const model = DATA.flightModel;
  const spec = model.burns[kind];
  const clamped = clamp01(fill);
  if (!spec) return { kind, fill: clamped, quality: 0, bonus: 0 };
  const quality = clamp01(1 - Math.abs(clamped - spec.target) / spec.zoneHalfWidth);
  return { kind, fill: clamped, quality, bonus: quality * spec.weight * model.burnBonusMax };
}

export function resolveFlight(telemetry, burns = null) {
  const model = DATA.flightModel;
  const contract = telemetry.C;
  const steps = [];

  const finish = (outcome, science, events, reasons, arrived = false) => ({
    outcome,
    arrived, // true once the craft is safely in orbit, even if the science was too low to count
    science,
    events,
    reasons,
    steps,
    reliability: telemetry.reliability,
    ...scoreFlight(telemetry, outcome, science)
  });

  const lose = (key, values, reasonKey) => {
    steps.push({ key, ok: false, fatal: true, values });
    const reason = CONTENT.flightFailures[reasonKey];
    return finish('lost', 0, [], [`${reason.why} Fix: ${reason.fix}`]);
  };

  const deltaV = telemetry.g('Delta-v');

  steps.push({
    key: 'liftoff',
    ok: true,
    values: { launcher: telemetry.L.n, massKg: telemetry.m0, reliabilityPct: telemetry.reliability }
  });

  if (telemetry.off > model.balanceLimitPx) {
    return lose('tumble', { offPx: telemetry.off, limitPx: model.balanceLimitPx }, 'tumble');
  }
  steps.push({ key: 'ascent', ok: true, values: { reliabilityPct: telemetry.reliability } });

  const feasibility = getFeasibility(contract);
  steps.push({
    key: 'feasibility',
    ok: true,
    values: {
      name: contract.n,
      cls: feasibility.cls,
      label: feasibility.lab,
      notes: feasibility.notes.join('; '),
      haveMs: telemetry.dv,
      needMs: deltaV.use,
      haveW: telemetry.sun,
      needW: telemetry.load,
      days: telemetry.days
    }
  });

  if (contract.doom) {
    CONTENT.sunDive.lines.forEach(([text, cls]) => {
      steps.push({ key: 'sun_dive', ok: cls !== 'bad', values: { text } });
    });
    steps.push({ key: 'sun_boom', ok: false, fatal: true, values: { text: CONTENT.sunDive.boom } });
    const sunReasons = CONTENT.sunDive.why.map((line, index) =>
      index === 0 ? `${line} Your craft had ${Math.round(telemetry.dv).toLocaleString()} m/s.` : line
    );
    return finish('lost', 0, [], sunReasons);
  }

  steps.push({ key: 'transfer', ok: deltaV.mg >= 0, values: { needMs: deltaV.use, haveMs: telemetry.dv } });
  if (deltaV.mg < 0) {
    return lose('deltav_short', { shortMs: deltaV.use - telemetry.dv }, 'deltav');
  }
  if (telemetry.E.pw && telemetry.g('Ion power').mg < 0) {
    return lose('ion_short', { needW: telemetry.E.pw }, 'ion');
  }

  const burnShare = kind => {
    const quality = getBurnQuality(burns, kind);
    return quality === null ? 0 : quality * model.burns[kind].weight * model.burnBonusMax;
  };
  const burnBonus = Math.min(model.burnBonusMax, BURN_ORDER.reduce((total, kind) => total + burnShare(kind), 0));
  const pushBurnStep = kind => {
    const quality = getBurnQuality(burns, kind);
    if (quality === null) return;
    steps.push({
      key: quality > 0 ? `burn_${kind}` : `burn_${kind}_miss`,
      ok: true,
      values: { precisionPct: quality, bonusPct: burnShare(kind) }
    });
  };

  pushBurnStep('departure');
  steps.push({ key: 'arrival', ok: true, values: { days: telemetry.days, orbit: telemetry.O.n.toLowerCase() } });
  pushBurnStep('insertion');
  steps.push({ key: 'briefing', ok: true, values: { contractId: contract.id } });

  const events = getTriggeredEvents(telemetry);
  events.forEach(event => {
    steps.push({
      key: 'event',
      ok: event.immune,
      values: {
        eventId: event.id,
        scienceFactor: event.scienceFactor,
        flareClass: appState.spaceWeather?.flareClass || 'M1.4'
      }
    });
  });

  const science = events.reduce((total, event) => total * event.scienceFactor, telemetry.sciF) * (1 + burnBonus);
  steps.push({
    key: 'operations',
    ok: true,
    values: { returnedPct: telemetry.ret, science, target: contract.target }
  });

  const outcome = classifyOutcome(science, contract);
  const minimumScience = contract.thr * model.failBelowThresholdFactor;

  const reasons = [];
  if (outcome === 'lost') {
    reasons.push(fillTemplate(CONTENT.flightFailures.belowMinimum, { sciPts: science, minPts: minimumScience }));
  }
  reasons.push(...telemetry.rows
    .filter(r => r.mg < appState.marginThreshold)
    .map(r => `${r.n}: ${r.why} Fix: ${r.fix} [${r.src}]`));

  if (telemetry.ret < 1 && telemetry.data) {
    reasons.push(fillTemplate(CONTENT.flightFailures.dataReturn, { returnedPct: telemetry.ret }));
  }

  events.filter(event => !event.immune).forEach(event => {
    const text = CONTENT.eventText[event.id];
    reasons.push(`${text.n}: ${text.hitT} ${fillTemplate(CONTENT.flightFailures.eventLoss, { lossPct: 1 - event.scienceFactor })} Fix: ${text.fix}`);
  });

  if (BURN_ORDER.every(kind => getBurnQuality(burns, kind) === null)) {
    reasons.push(fillTemplate(CONTENT.flightFailures.burnAuto, { maxBonusPct: model.burnBonusMax }));
  } else {
    BURN_ORDER.forEach(kind => {
      const quality = getBurnQuality(burns, kind);
      const name = CONTENT.burn[kind].name;
      if (quality === null) {
        reasons.push(fillTemplate(CONTENT.flightFailures.burnSkipped, { name }));
      } else if (quality > 0) {
        reasons.push(fillTemplate(CONTENT.flightFailures.burn, { name, precisionPct: quality, bonusPct: burnShare(kind) }));
      } else {
        reasons.push(fillTemplate(CONTENT.flightFailures.burnMiss, { name }));
      }
    });
  }

  const reliabilityLine = fillTemplate(CONTENT.flightFailures.reliability, {
    reliabilityPct: telemetry.reliability,
    launcherPct: telemetry.reliabilityParts.launcher,
    busPct: telemetry.reliabilityParts.bus,
    adjustmentPct: telemetry.reliabilityParts.adjustment
  });
  reasons.push(reliabilityLine + (telemetry.reliabilityParts.adjustment < 0 ? CONTENT.flightFailures.reliabilityFix : ''));

  return finish(outcome, science, events, reasons, true);
}

/* File: js/core/planets.js

import { DATA } from '../api/mockData.js';
import { CONTENT } from '../content.js';

/**
 * Best delta-v (km/s) the game lets you build: super-heavy launcher, hardened bus, as many tanks as fit.
 * Used only to label how hard a destination is before the player designs anything.
 */
const BEST_BUILDABLE_DV = (() => {
  const tank = DATA.tank;
  const bus = DATA.parts.bus_rad;
  const result = {};

  for (const key of ['chem', 'nuclear']) {
    const engine = DATA.engines[key];
    let best = 0;
    for (let tanks = 1; tanks <= 8; tanks++) {
      const dry = bus.m + engine.m + tanks * tank.dry + 250;
      const wet = dry + tanks * tank.prop;
      if (wet <= DATA.launchers.super.cap) {
        best = Math.max(best, engine.isp * DATA.constants.g0.value * Math.log(wet / dry));
      }
    }
    result[key] = best / 1000;
  }
  return result;
})();

/**
 * Rates a destination before design: Feasible, Hard, Extreme, Beyond current engines, or IMPOSSIBLE.
 * Returns { lab, cls, notes[], dv } where cls is a colour class (g / y / r).
 */
export function getFeasibility(contract) {
  if (contract.doom) {
    return { lab: 'IMPOSSIBLE', cls: 'r', notes: ['no spacecraft can survive it; try it and see why'], dv: Infinity };
  }

  const cheapestDv = Math.min(...contract.orbits.map(o => o.dv));
  const chemical = BEST_BUILDABLE_DV.chem;
  const nuclear = BEST_BUILDABLE_DV.nuclear;
  const sunlight = DATA.solarFluxFactor[contract.dest].value;
  const commsFactor = DATA.commsDistanceFactor[contract.dest].value;
  const tripDays = DATA.transitDaysBase[contract.dest].value;

  let lab;
  let cls;
  if (cheapestDv <= chemical * 0.65) { lab = 'Feasible'; cls = 'g'; }
  else if (cheapestDv <= chemical * 0.95) { lab = 'Hard: giant chemical rocket'; cls = 'y'; }
  else if (cheapestDv <= nuclear * 0.95) { lab = 'Extreme: needs nuclear engine'; cls = 'y'; }
  else { lab = 'Beyond current engines'; cls = 'r'; }

  const notes = [
    `needs at least ${cheapestDv.toFixed(1)} km/s of delta-v`,
    `trip about ${tripDays < 120 ? `${tripDays} days` : `${(tripDays / 365).toFixed(1)} years`} (chemical engine)`
  ];
  if (sunlight < 0.2) notes.push(`sunlight only ${(sunlight * 100).toFixed(1)}% of Earth’s: bring radioisotope generators`);
  else if (sunlight > 2.5) notes.push(`sunlight ${sunlight}x Earth’s: heat is the enemy`);
  if (commsFactor < 0.05) notes.push(`weak signal: only ${(commsFactor * 100).toFixed(1)}% of the data rate, choose light instruments`);

  return { lab, cls, notes, dv: cheapestDv };
}

/** Destination briefing (gravity, climate, moons...) as an HTML snippet. `welcome` adds a heading line. */
export function buildPlanetBriefing(contractId, welcome = false) {
  const info = CONTENT.planetInfo[contractId];
  if (!info) return '';
  const felt = Math.round(70 * info.gx);
  return `<span class="pin">${welcome ? `<b>Welcome to ${info.name}</b><br>` : ''}` +
    `<b>Gravity:</b> ${info.grav} m/s² (${info.gx}x Earth). A 70 kg person would feel like ${felt} kg${info.gnote ? ` (${info.gnote})` : ''}.<br>` +
    `<b>Environment:</b> ${info.env}<br>` +
    `<b>Temperature:</b> ${info.temp}<br>` +
    `<b>Atmosphere:</b> ${info.atm}<br>` +
    `<b>Day and year:</b> ${info.day}<br>` +
    `<b>Moons and rings:</b> ${info.moons}<br>` +
    `<b>Unique:</b> ${info.uniq}</span>`;
}

const MISSION_STORAGE_KEY = 'apogeeMissionState';
const SAVED_BUILDS_KEY = 'apogeeSavedBuilds';

export function createInitialMission(contractIndex = 1) {

    stage: 1,
    ci: contractIndex,
    oi: 0,
    L: 'medium',
    parts: [],
    nu: 1,
    mirror: true,

}

export const appState = {
  mission: createInitialMission(1),
  marginThreshold: 0.1,
  candidates: [],
  savedBuilds: [],
  previousErrorCount: 0,
  highScores: {},
  isFlying: false,
  selectedPartUid: null,
  canvasZoom: 0.9,
  undoHistory: [],
  activeDrag: null,
  dataSourceLabel: 'Offline sample',
  spaceWeather: {
    isLive: false,
    flareClass: 'M1.4 (Baseline)',
    flareCount: 3,
    cmeCount: 2,
    stormLevel: 'Moderate',
    radiationMultiplier: 1.0,
    summary: 'Solar wind & flare baseline (offline fallback — check internet connection for live NASA DONKI telemetry).',
    src: 'SIMPLIFIED_FOR_GAMEPLAY'
  }
};

try {
  appState.highScores = JSON.parse(localStorage.tm || '{}');
} catch {
  appState.highScores = {};
}

try {
  const rawBuilds = JSON.parse(localStorage[SAVED_BUILDS_KEY] || '[]');
  if (Array.isArray(rawBuilds)) appState.savedBuilds = rawBuilds;
} catch {
  appState.savedBuilds = [];
}

function persistSavedBuilds() {
  try {
    localStorage[SAVED_BUILDS_KEY] = JSON.stringify(appState.savedBuilds);
  } catch {}
}

export function saveNamedBuild(customName = '') {
  const { parts, nu, L, oi, ci, hard, seed, d } = appState.mission;
  if (!parts.length) return { ok: false, message: 'Add at least one part before saving a build.' };

  const contractName = DATA.contracts[ci]?.n || 'Mission';
  const name = customName.trim() || `${contractName} Build #${appState.savedBuilds.length + 1}`;
  const entry = {
    id: `build_${Date.now()}`,
    name,
    savedAt: new Date().toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),
    mission: { parts: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(parts)), nu, L, oi, ci, hard, seed },
    summary: {
      contract: contractName,
      orbit: DATA.contracts[ci]?.orbits[oi]?.n || '',
      launcher: DATA.launchers[L]?.n || L,
      massKg: d ? Math.round(d.m0) : 0,
      dvMs: d ? Math.round(d.dv) : 0,
      costM: d ? Math.round(d.cost) : 0,
      partCount: parts.length
    }
  };

  appState.savedBuilds.unshift(entry);
  if (appState.savedBuilds.length > MAX_SAVED_BUILDS) {
    appState.savedBuilds.length = MAX_SAVED_BUILDS;
  }
  persistSavedBuilds();
  return { ok: true, entry };
}

export function deleteSavedBuild(buildId) {
  appState.savedBuilds = appState.savedBuilds.filter(b => b.id !== buildId);
  persistSavedBuilds();
}

export function saveMissionProgress() {
  try {
    const { d, res, ...serializable } = appState.mission;
    localStorage[MISSION_STORAGE_KEY] = JSON.stringify({
      mission: serializable,
      candidates: appState.candidates
    });
  } catch {}
}

export function loadSavedMissionProgress() {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage[MISSION_STORAGE_KEY];
    if (!raw) return false;
    const saved = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (saved && saved.mission && Array.isArray(saved.mission.parts) && saved.mission.parts.length > 0) {
      const validParts = saved.mission.parts.every(
        p => p.id === 'tank' || DATA.parts[p.id] || DATA.engines[p.id]
      );
      if (validParts && DATA.contracts[saved.mission.ci] && DATA.launchers[saved.mission.L]) {
        appState.mission = { ...createInitialMission(saved.mission.ci), ...saved.mission, stage: 1 };
        if (Array.isArray(saved.candidates)) {
          appState.candidates = saved.candidates.slice(0, 3);
        }
        return true;
      }
    }
  } catch {}
  return false;
}

export function getNodeCategory(partId) {
  if (partId === 'tank') return 'tank';
  if (DATA.engines[partId]) return 'eng';
  if (DATA.parts[partId]?.g === 'bus') return 'bus';
  if (partId.startsWith('sol')) return 'sol';
  if (partId.startsWith('ant')) return 'ant';
  return 'sm';
}

export function getDimensionKey(partId) {
  if (partId === 'tank') return 'tank';
  if (DATA.engines[partId]) return partId === 'ion' ? 'ion' : 'eng';
  if (partId.startsWith('bus')) return 'bus';
  return partId;
}

export function getAssetFilename(partId) {
  if (partId === 'tank') return 'part_tank';
  if (DATA.engines[partId]) return DATA.engines[partId].img;
  return partId;
}

export function saveUndoSnapshot() {
  appState.undoHistory.push(JSON.stringify([appState.mission.parts, appState.mission.nu]));
  if (appState.undoHistory.length > MAX_HISTORY) {
    appState.undoHistory.shift();
  }
}

/* ---- Web Audio Synthesizer & Smooth Crossfading Screen Music Controller ---- */
export const AudioEngine = (() => {
  const MAX_MUSIC_VOL = 0.48;
  const MAX_SFX_GAIN = 0.6;
  const CROSSFADE_MS = 700;

  let savedLevel = 0.75;
  try {
    const raw = parseFloat(localStorage[VOLUME_STORAGE_KEY]);
    if (!Number.isNaN(raw) && raw >= 0 && raw <= 1) savedLevel = raw;
  } catch {}

  let ctx = null;
  let masterGain = null;
  let masterLevel = savedLevel;
  let lastNonZeroLevel = savedLevel > 0 ? savedLevel : 0.75;
  let isSoundOn = savedLevel > 0;
  let activeTrackKey = 'landing';
  let activeAudioEl = null;
  let unlockBound = false;

  const trackElements = {};
  const fadeTimers = new WeakMap();

  const getMusicTargetVolume = () => (isSoundOn ? MAX_MUSIC_VOL * masterLevel : 0);
  const getSfxTargetGain = () => (isSoundOn ? MAX_SFX_GAIN * masterLevel : 0);

  const persistVolume = () => {
    try {
      localStorage[VOLUME_STORAGE_KEY] = String(masterLevel);
    } catch {}
  };

  const fadeAudio = (audio, targetVol, durationMs, onDone = null) => {
    if (!audio) return;
    const prevRaf = fadeTimers.get(audio);
    if (prevRaf) cancelAnimationFrame(prevRaf);

    const startVol = audio.volume;
    const startTime = performance.now();

    const step = now => {
      const progress = Math.min(1, (now - startTime) / durationMs);
      const eased = progress < 0.5
        ? 2 * progress * progress
        : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * progress + 2, 2) / 2;

      audio.volume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, startVol + (targetVol - startVol) * eased));

      if (progress < 1) {
        fadeTimers.set(audio, requestAnimationFrame(step));
      } else {
        fadeTimers.delete(audio);
        if (onDone) onDone();
      }
    };

    fadeTimers.set(audio, requestAnimationFrame(step));
  };

  const getTrackElement = key => {
    if (trackElements[key]) return trackElements[key];
    const src = CONTENT.audioTracks?.[key];
    if (!src) return null;

    const audio = new Audio(src);
    audio.preload = 'auto';
    audio.loop = key === 'landing' || key === 'design';
    audio.volume = 0;
    audio.onerror = () => {
      audio.dataset.missing = '1';
    };
    trackElements[key] = audio;
    return audio;
  };

  const fadeOutAndStop = audio => {
    if (!audio) return;
    fadeAudio(audio, 0, CROSSFADE_MS, () => {
      audio.pause();
      audio.currentTime = 0;
    });
  };

  const bindAutoplayUnlock = () => {
    if (unlockBound) return;
    unlockBound = true;

    const unlock = () => {
      init();
      if (isSoundOn && activeTrackKey) {
        const el = getTrackElement(activeTrackKey);
        if (el && el.dataset.missing !== '1' && el.paused) {
          el.volume = 0;
          el.play()
            .then(() => {
              fadeAudio(el, getMusicTargetVolume(), CROSSFADE_MS);
              cleanup();
            })
            .catch(() => {});
        } else if (el && !el.paused) {
          cleanup();
        }
      } else {
        cleanup();
      }
    };

    const cleanup = () => {
      ['pointerdown', 'keydown', 'touchstart'].forEach(evt =>
        document.removeEventListener(evt, unlock, true)
      );
    };

    ['pointerdown', 'keydown', 'touchstart'].forEach(evt =>
      document.addEventListener(evt, unlock, true)
    );
  };

  const playTrack = (key, forceRestart = false) => {
    activeTrackKey = key;
    if (!isSoundOn) return;

    if (!key) {
      if (activeAudioEl) {
        fadeOutAndStop(activeAudioEl);
        activeAudioEl = null;
      }
      return;
    }

    const nextEl = getTrackElement(key);
    if (!nextEl || nextEl.dataset.missing === '1') {
      if (activeAudioEl) {
        fadeOutAndStop(activeAudioEl);
        activeAudioEl = null;
      }
      return;
    }

    if (activeAudioEl === nextEl && !nextEl.paused && !forceRestart) {
      fadeAudio(nextEl, getMusicTargetVolume(), CROSSFADE_MS);
      return;
    }

    if (activeAudioEl && activeAudioEl !== nextEl) {
      fadeOutAndStop(activeAudioEl);
    }

    activeAudioEl = nextEl;
    if (forceRestart) nextEl.currentTime = 0;
    nextEl.volume = 0;
    nextEl.play()
      .then(() => fadeAudio(nextEl, getMusicTargetVolume(), CROSSFADE_MS))
      .catch(() => bindAutoplayUnlock());
  };

  const init = () => {
    if (!ctx) {
      const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
      if (AudioCtx) {
        ctx = new AudioCtx();
        masterGain = ctx.createGain();
        masterGain.gain.value = getSfxTargetGain();
        masterGain.connect(ctx.destination);
      }
    }
    if (ctx && ctx.state === 'suspended') {
      ctx.resume().catch(() => {});
    }
  };

  const playTone = (freq, delay, duration, type = 'sine', volume = 0.2, endFreq = null) => {
    if (!isSoundOn || masterLevel <= 0) return;
    init();
    if (!ctx) return;
    const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
    const gain = ctx.createGain();
    const startTime = ctx.currentTime + delay;

    osc.type = type;
    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, startTime);
    if (endFreq) osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(endFreq, startTime + duration);

    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(volume, startTime);
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, startTime + duration);

    osc.connect(gain);
    gain.connect(masterGain);
    osc.start(startTime);
    osc.stop(startTime + duration);
  };

  return {
    init,
    isEnabled: () => isSoundOn,
    getVolume: () => Math.round(masterLevel * 100),
    setVolume(percent) {
      const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Number(percent) || 0)) / 100;
      masterLevel = clamped;
      if (clamped > 0) {
        lastNonZeroLevel = clamped;
        isSoundOn = true;
      } else {
        isSoundOn = false;
      }
      persistVolume();
      init();
      if (masterGain) masterGain.gain.value = getSfxTargetGain();

      if (isSoundOn) {
        if (activeAudioEl && !activeAudioEl.paused) {
          const prevRaf = fadeTimers.get(activeAudioEl);
          if (prevRaf) cancelAnimationFrame(prevRaf);
          activeAudioEl.volume = getMusicTargetVolume();
        } else {
          playTrack(activeTrackKey || 'landing');
        }
      } else if (activeAudioEl) {
        fadeOutAndStop(activeAudioEl);
        activeAudioEl = null;
      }
      return { isSoundOn, volumePct: Math.round(masterLevel * 100) };
    },
    setMusic: (key, forceRestart = false) => playTrack(key, forceRestart),
    toggleMute() {
      isSoundOn = !isSoundOn;
      if (isSoundOn && masterLevel <= 0) {
        masterLevel = lastNonZeroLevel;
      }
      persistVolume();
      init();
      if (masterGain) masterGain.gain.value = getSfxTargetGain();
      if (isSoundOn) {
        playTrack(activeTrackKey || 'landing');
      } else if (activeAudioEl) {
        fadeOutAndStop(activeAudioEl);
        activeAudioEl = null;
      }
      return { isSoundOn, volumePct: Math.round(masterLevel * 100) };
    },
    click: () => playTone(660, 0, 0.05, 'square', 0.06),
    attach: () => {
      playTone(520, 0, 0.08, 'triangle', 0.14);
      playTone(780, 0.07, 0.1, 'triangle', 0.11);
    },
    remove: () => playTone(420, 0, 0.12, 'triangle', 0.12, 240),
    warn: () => {
      playTone(310, 0, 0.14, 'sawtooth', 0.07);
      playTone(310, 0.2, 0.14, 'sawtooth', 0.07);
    },
    tick: () => playTone(900, 0, 0.04, 'square', 0.05),
    launch: () => playTone(65, 0, 2.5, 'sawtooth', 0.14, 110),
    win: () => {
      playTrack('win', true);
      [523, 659, 784, 1047].forEach((f, i) => playTone(f, i * 0.14, 0.45, 'triangle', 0.16));
    },
    partial: () => {
      // Partial success is not a win: short two-note chime only, no victory track.
      [523, 659].forEach((f, i) => playTone(f, i * 0.2, 0.45, 'triangle', 0.14));
    },
    fail: () => {
      playTrack('loss', true);
      playTone(120, 0, 1.0, 'sawtooth', 0.22, 35);
    }
  };
})();

import { CONTENT } from './content.js';
import { fetchMissionReferenceData } from './api/nasaService.js';
import {
  appState,
  createInitialMission,
  loadSavedMissionProgress,
  AudioEngine
} from './core/state.js';
import { buildStarterSpacecraft } from './core/engine.js';

function initBackgroundVideo() {
  const videoEl = $('#bg');
  if (!videoEl) return;
  if (matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) {
    videoEl.remove();
    return;
  }
  videoEl.onerror = () => videoEl.remove();
  videoEl.src = CONTENT.bgVideo;
  videoEl.play().catch(() => {});
}

async function initApp() {
  initBackgroundVideo();

  $('#cr').textContent = CONTENT.bgCredit;
  $('#title-disclaimer').textContent = CONTENT.disclaimer;
  document.title = `${CONTENT.appName} — Space Mission Design Game`;
  $('#hn').textContent = CONTENT.appName;
  $('#tt').textContent = CONTENT.appName;
  $('#tg').textContent = CONTENT.tagline;
  renderHelpModal();

  const restored = loadSavedMissionProgress();
  if (!restored) {
    appState.mission = createInitialMission(1);
    buildStarterSpacecraft();
  }

  bindGlobalControls();
  AudioEngine.setMusic('landing');
  navigateToStage(1);

  try {
    const serviceResult = await fetchMissionReferenceData();
    appState.dataSourceLabel = serviceResult.sourceMode;
    appState.spaceWeather = serviceResult.spaceWeather;
    if (appState.mission.stage === 1) {
      navigateToStage(1);
    }
  } catch {}
}

initApp();

import { DATA } from '../api/mockData.js';
import { isContractOpen, isDeveloperMode, toggleDeveloperMode, resetCareer } from '../core/career.js';
import { ATTACHMENT_NODES, MAX_PARTS, SNAP_RADIUS_PX } from '../config.js';

  appState,
  getNodeCategory,

  saveMissionProgress,
  saveNamedBuild,
  deleteSavedBuild,
  AudioEngine
} from '../core/state.js';

  findPartByUid,
  getNodeWorldPosition,
  getSubtreeUids,

  createPartInstance,
  deletePartSubtree,

} from '../core/engine.js';
import { $, showToast } from './domElements.js';
